{'content': '女星阿曼達施菲宣布與丈夫湯馬士沙多斯基分居，稱此舉「對我們而言是正確的決定」。', 'translations': ['Actress Amanda Seyfried has announced she is separating from her husband Thomas Sadoski, calling the move "the right decision for us."']}

{'content': '兩人向該雜誌發表聲明表示：「我們分居已經有一段時間，證明了這對我們和我們的家庭而言是正確的決定。我們會永遠珍惜彼此——這是好的。」', 'translations': ['The pair said in a statement to the magazine: "We have been separated for some time now, and this has proven to be the right decision for us and our family. We will always cherish each other — it\'s good."']}

{'content': '施菲曾出演《下女》和《賤女孩》，沙多斯基則因電視劇《Life in Pieces》為人熟悉。兩人於2015年在一部外百老匯話劇中相識，其後在薛莉莉麥蓮（Shirley MacLaine）主演的电影《The Last Word》中飾演情侶，並於2017年3月私奔結婚。', 'translations': ['Seyfried has appeared in "The Handmaiden" and "Mean Girls," while Sadoski is known for the TV series "Life in Pieces." The two met in 2015 while working on an off-Broadway play and later played a couple in the Shirley MacLaine-starring film "The Last Word," before eloping in March 2017.']}

{'content': '據《Vogue》一月報道，一家人在他們經營的一個動物救援農場生活，孩子們就在附近的學校上學。', 'translations': ['The family has been living on an animal rescue farm that they operate, with their children attending a local school, according to a January report by Vogue.']}

{'content': '這位《媽媽咪呀！》女星告訴該雜誌，她的丈夫「為我作出了很多犧牲」。', 'translations': ['The "Mamma Mia!" star told the magazine that her husband "made a lot of sacrifices for me."']}

{'content': '她說：「他亦都知道，在這個時刻，我所獲得的機會是難以置信的。」她又表示：「我經常拒絕好多邀約。」', 'translations': ['"He also knows that the opportunities I have in this moment are incredible," she said. "I turn down so much."']}

{'content': '在剛過去星期日多倫多國際電影節其新片《The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd》放映活動上，她手上似乎沒有戴結婚戒指。', 'translations': ['She did not appear to be wearing her wedding ring at the Toronto International Film Festival on Sunday for a screening of her new film "The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd."']}
